description.value: Busaba Thai Cafe is a family-owned authentic Thai restaurant in Creston, BC, and one of two locations operated by the same family (the other in Nelson). The kitchen draws on regional Thai cuisines — Northern farmlands, Central floating markets, and Southern fishing villages — using imported Thai spices alongside fresh local ingredients. Touring cyclists will find a stylish dine-in space with takeout available and menu options clearly labelled for dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Creston subpage at busabathaicafe.com/creston-busaba/ confirms the OSM address (223 10th Ave N), phone (236-351-4000), and that the restaurant is open for dine-in and takeout. The website lists Gluten-Free and Vegan options explicitly. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site. The OSM name is 'Busaba Thai Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Busaba Thai Cafe' — flagged in concerns.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Busaba Thai Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Busaba Thai Cafe' / 'BUSABA Thai Cafe' and the domain is busabathaicafe.com.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by current website content with matching address and phone.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Creston subpage explicitly lists 'Gluten-Free Options' and 'Vegan Options' under BUSABA MENU OPTIONS
